modalities.value: Vision-language model: image and text in, text out

source.quote: PaliGemma is an open Vision-Language Model (VLM) that is based on the SigLIP-So400m vision encoder

languages.value: WebLI captioning in over 100 languages; CC3M-35L and related tasks in 35 languages

architecture.value: SigLIP-So400m (400M) vision encoder + linear projection + Gemma-2B decoder LM; three resolution checkpoints (224/448/896)

source.quote: Figure 1 | PaliGemma’s architecture: a SigLIP image encoder feeds into a Gemma decoder LM.

trainingData.value: Broad multimodal mixture (captioning on WebLI and CC3M-35L, VQA/VQG, OCR, detection/segmentation, grounded captioning, and related tasks); some pretraining datasets remain private; transfer tasks held out

trainingCompute.value: TPUv5e-256: Stage1 slightly less than 3 days (~350 B tokens); each Stage2 about 15h (~90 B tokens combined for both Stage2)

notes: Technical report (arXiv:2407.07726), not a system card. No formal risk framework or external safety testers. Only safety-relevant numeric eval is POPE (object hallucination); FairFace/toxicity and human safety prompts appear on the separate model card, not this PDF. Table 1 POPE columns map to the pt-224 and pt-448 checkpoints (VQAv2-transfer zero-shot). Mix-224/mix-448 covered because the report describes providing a mix transfer checkpoint; Table 4 multitask results have no POPE row. Skipped capability benchmarks per pilot rules (captioning, VQA, OCR, segmentation, video, Objaverse, etc.). Two-column PDF layout makes some quotes include adjacent-column text.
